**Article Details for PMID: 29135110**

**Title:** Pathway cross-talk network strategy reveals key pathways in non-small cell lung cancer.

**Authors:** Meng-Li Zheng, Nai-Kang Zhou, De-Liang Huang, Cheng-Hua Luo

**Journal:** Journal of B.U.ON. : official journal of the Balkan Union of Oncology
**Publication Date:** 2019-07-31

**Abstract:**
The purpose of this study was to explore the pathway cross-talks and key pathways in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) to better understand the underlying pathological mechanism.

**Note:** Full text is not available in PubMed Central. You may need institutional access or subscription to view the complete article.
